title: Brokoli task bundle v2 manifest (ADR-033)
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for a brokoli.task-bundle/v2 manifest (ADR-033 section 2) -- the deployment-scoped, content-addressed artifact a 'task' IR node references. This is a rollout-phase-0 artifact (ADR-032/033 rollout, issue #439 step 5): it defines the manifest shape and its fixtures without wiring archive extraction, digest verification, or dispatch -- see docs/schema/task-bundle-v2-canonicalization.md for the archive-level rules this schema cannot express (canonicalization, path safety, digest coverage). Distinct from and additive alongside pkg/taskbundle's task-bundle/1 (ADR-031), which this schema does not replace or describe (ADR-035 Decision 1). A change here is a change to every SDK and the core validator at once: version it accordingly, per the same discipline as task-interface-v1.json.

interface_digest.description: The ADR-032 task interface digest this bundle implements, verified against the referencing 'task' node's logical IR at admission (ADR-033 section 2 rule 4).

build.description: Additive build provenance (ADR-033 section 2 rule 6). Optional in v1: digest verification of the manifest/payloads is mandatory regardless of whether build provenance is present.

builder.description: The SDK/tool identity that produced this bundle, e.g. 'brokoli-python-sdk/0.9.0'.

runtime.description: Runtime class (ADR-033 section 3) -- how this payload is launched, not the task's business semantics.

requires.description: Runtime version range this payload requires, e.g. '>=3.11,<3.14'. Absent for runtime classes with no interpreter version (native, container).

os.description: 'any' or a specific OS name (ADR-033 section 2 rule 10).

arch.description: 'any' or a specific architecture name (ADR-033 section 2 rule 10).

effects.description: Effect class (ADR-033 section 14). Changing it changes implementation identity.

dependency_lock.description: Relative path (within 'files') to this payload's hash-verifiable dependency lock (ADR-033 section 2 rule 5). Absent only when the payload has no dependencies.

image.description: Present only when runtime is 'container' (ADR-033 section 2 rule 11): an immutable external OCI image reference. Its layers need not be copied into the bundle archive, but this reference is covered by the bundle digest.

digest.description: OCI image manifest digest -- a different digest namespace than this schema's own 'sha256:...' content-address digests, but the same syntax.

reference.description: Optional human-readable image reference (registry/repo:tag) for diagnostics only; the digest is authoritative.

entrypoint.description: One structured entrypoint grammar (ADR-033 section 2 rule 9). Free-form colon/dot strings are not a portable entrypoint.

executable.description: Relative path (within 'files') to the native executable.

path.description: Relative, normalized path (ADR-033 section 2 rule 2) -- absolute paths and '..' segments are archive-level rejections, not expressible as a JSON string pattern here; see the canonicalization companion doc.
